name: mcp-status-refactor
description: Expose the ACP method _iflow/mcp/status: per-MCP-server connection state (the Djt map vk() writes, same source /mcp list renders), discovery state Rjt(), tool/prompt counts, the tool declarations (name/description/schema) for detail views and context-length estimation, and the connection error captured at the k2n catch site (errorKind classified). Gated to --experimental-acp; IFLOW_MCP_STATUS=0|false reverts; loader missing degrades to {available:false} instead of a protocol error.
author: yuentao
